about: Colwood is a city in the West Shore of Greater Victoria, British Columbia, between Esquimalt Harbour approaches and the Juan de Fuca shoreline toward Langford and Metchosin. Suburban neighbourhoods, ocean parks, and Royal Roads / Hatley heritage grounds shape a growing capital-region municipality. About 19,000 people live in Colwood.
